title: Three packages
description: Within the exercise base, create three packages: `a`, `b`, and `c`. Create class `A` inside the package `a`, class `B` inside the package `b`, and class `C` inside the package `c`. The classes don't need object variables, constructors, or methods.

paragraphs: Within the exercise base, create three packages: `a`, `b`, and `c`. Create class `A` inside the package `a`, class `B` inside the package `b`, and class `C` inside the package `c`. The classes don't need object variables, constructors, or methods.
